# TensionKind

How two threads pull against each other.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Contradicts"` | The two threads cannot both be true. |
| `"Supersedes"` | The newer thread appears to replace the older. |
| `"Diverges"` | Different perspectives that need not be reconciled. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`LoomTension`](loom-tension.md)
